readme:
# Archived wiki pages

Pages moved here by `tools/wiki_prune.py`, under mechanical rules with a stated reason for each move (see `LOG.md`). Nothing in this folder is indexed, searched or linted; it is kept so that a move can be undone and a reason can be read.

The rules: a filed analysis that nothing linked to for 30 days (research, decision and dialectic notes never age out); a summary whose source left the compiled roots, unlinked for 60 days; any page with no link in or out for 60 days that no job would rebuild.

To restore a page: `git mv` it back to the path in the log and mark the row restored.
